title: HIIR HANNA JA SIIL SASS TEEVAD LOHET

characters.name: HIIR HANNA
characters.description: Väike hall hiir suurte roosade kõrvadega, kandmas väikest sinist vesti ja rõõmsat naeratust. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SASS
characters.description: Väike pruun siil pehmete okastega, kandmas väikest rohelist salli, suured uudishimulikud silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Käsitöötuba
locations.description: Cozy children's craft room with light blue painted walls, a light wooden floor, and a large window on the back wall showing a sunny spring landscape with green trees and a few small white clouds. A simple, small wooden table is in the center with two small chairs. A low, open shelf with colorful craft supplies (papers, crayons) is on the right wall. A string with a few cheerful paper stars hangs on the back wall. Bright, natural light from the window. Cheerful and inviting atmosphere. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Päikeseline Rohuväli
locations.description: A sunny, expansive grassy field. Lush green grass covers the ground, with gently rolling hills in the distance. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds. A few distant green trees are visible on the horizon. The atmosphere is open, windy, and joyful, depicting a fresh spring day. Cartoon style.
